historical_reviews.deepseek: Its no-guess decision is sound. However, the row does not prove raw access is the only route; standard SDR coverage must be inventoried before requiring a vendor payload.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates vendor commands and separates project inputs from an irreducible block. This review adds memory-stack or module attribution and rejects GPU-core temperature as substitute evidence.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code variant exists. The preceding TEMP_GPU 0~N row cannot cover memory temperature, and the following UBB GPU row names another sensor family.

original_test_intent: Verify the memory-temperature channel associated with every applicable GPU index, including correct accelerator-to-memory sensor attribution, human-readable identity and reading, and parity among SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The GPU thermal owner expands 0~N_Memory by installed accelerator and memory sensor domain, maps each entry to a documented standard record or approved vendor read plus its Web row, defines memory-specific temperature limits, and automation gathers aligned passive evidence.
manual_activity: The GPU thermal owner identifies which memory sensor belongs to each accelerator, whether it represents aggregate HBM temperature, hotspot or a specific stack/module, supplies memory-specific limits and approves the read/decode path and Web mapping.
required_inputs: Installed GPU index/slot/model/serial and memory technology/topology
Exact 0~N_Memory membership and per-GPU aggregate-versus-stack/module meaning
Stable standard SDR record/entity or pinned read-only vendor netfn/cmd/data bytes
Vendor response length, field offsets, signedness, scale, units, invalid markers and completion codes
GPU-memory idle/load operating range, warning/critical thresholds, tolerance, freshness and ambient/load context
BMC/SDR/GPU firmware, driver and BMC-Web row mapping
Secret-safe collection path, full evidence retention and log policy
Memory thermal aborts and independent cooling/console recovery
safety_requirements: Keep memory-temperature evidence distinct from GPU die/board and adjacent UBB channels
Expand each applicable GPU and memory sensor; do not pass the range using one aggregate example unless the SPEC explicitly defines it
Inventory standard SDR/Sensor records before invoking vendor raw access
Never guess, scan or mutate raw IPMI commands; only execute pinned read-only bytes with known decoding
Do not generate workload, change GPU power/clocks/fans, reset/flash BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid memory temperature, unsafe rise, unexpected response length/code or BMC instability
Protect credentials and never automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify row identity, accelerator inventory and memory sensor granularity
Capture complete standard SDR and Sensor List data
Run only an owner-approved read-only vendor query if standard records do not cover the target
Decode each memory channel exactly and create a per-GPU memory-to-Web comparison
Correlate passive GPU health, throttling, fan, SEL and BMC state
Perform no workload, control action, guessed payload or final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve accelerator and memory-sensor membership and granularity
Approve the exact standard/vendor method and byte decoding
Define memory-specific ranges, thresholds, freshness and context
Confirm Web mappings and decide PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED for every member

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Refusing an unspecified raw command is correct. The assertion that implementation-specific bytes are required must be validated against the platform's complete standard SDR inventory before any raw method is selected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete standard read-only SDR/Sensor inventories first; when GPU-memory records are absent, use only a documented version-pinned vendor read with exact response decoding, then compare every mapped memory channel with its BMC-Web value.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_GPU 0~N_Memory, BMC GUI, all three criteria and 3/3-minute estimates remain; member count, sensor granularity, bytes and limits are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GPU-MEMORY SENSOR PACKAGE AND PINNED READ METHOD
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish accelerator-to-memory-channel provenance, prefer standard sensors, otherwise apply a version-controlled vendor read/decoder, and compare timestamp-aligned memory readings across machine and Web views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds memory-domain attribution and a safe method-selection gate rather than treating unspecified raw bytes as an executable command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: GPU core or board temperature cannot stand in for HBM/VRAM temperature; a single aggregate reading covers individual stacks only if the approved specification says so.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Passive telemetry is low impact, but a guessed command or wrong scale/signedness can hide a memory hotspot and invalidate thermal acceptance.

project_override_considerations: Accelerators that expose only aggregate memory temperature require an explicit coverage ruling for stack/module names. GPU models without accessible memory telemetry need an owner-approved not-applicable or alternate documented read path, not reuse of core temperature.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and separation from GPU-device/UBB rows
Installed accelerator and memory topology with 0~N_Memory applicability
Per-member aggregate/stack/module meaning, stable sensor identity and Web mapping
Approved read method with version and, if raw, exact bytes/completion codes/decoding
Memory-specific thermal limits, tolerance, freshness, load and ambient context
Complete redacted SDR/Sensor and approved vendor outputs with exit status/timestamps
Per-member cross-view result plus throttling/fan/SEL/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and criteria consistently identify GPU-memory sensors and three-view comparison. Missing topology, method and expected values are incompleteness, not contradictory identities.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The GPU-memory monitoring purpose is clear and can use passive evidence after the project provides membership and a documented read/decoder package. Those are readiness inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Makes memory-stack/module provenance explicit, bars GPU core temperature from replacing memory telemetry, and turns the unspecified raw-command placeholder into a standard-first, pinned-decoder workflow.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU memory can expose an aggregate temperature, per-stack values or no BMC-visible telemetry at all, depending on accelerator and firmware. Therefore the suffix `_Memory` must bind to a documented thermal domain and cannot inherit the preceding GPU sensor's meaning. If vendor bytes are needed, field layout, scale and invalid encodings are as important as the payload itself; otherwise a plausible numeric value may be dangerously misdecoded.
